text:
Omar (Support): FYI, Halogen Health's onboarding is blocked — embedding ingest fails intermittently and they hit quota spikes. Customer flagged renewal impact. Need CS triage and a comms plan. ticket# 98214
Lina (CS Manager): ack. Can you paste the failure pattern + earliest ETA to join a customer call? :eyes:
Omar (Support): Error pops during batch ingest ~every 10-12 minutes after first run. Risk: customer cannot complete pilot validation. They asked to escalate to CS. cc @Devon
Devon (Solutions Eng): looking — can you share the ingest job command and last 3 logs? Likely a transient rate / backpressure issue from the dedupe step.
Evelyn (Customer): we're stuck on step 3 of the playbook. Upload succeeds but embeddings missing after ~5k rows. We've tried re-running, same behavior. Renewal decision next week.
Omar (Support): paste logs below:
```
2026-03-23T15:04:02Z ERROR ingest-worker-12 failed batch=487: kv-write timeout
2026-03-23T15:04:13Z WARN retrying batch=487 attempt=2 code=E_BACKPRESSURE
2026-03-23T15:04:25Z ERROR batch=487 aborting: downstream 503
```
Devon (Solutions Eng): thanks. Looks like their pipeline is hitting transient 503s from our vector-store adapter; I'll triage config and suggest increasing parallelism throttle and enabling prefix caching.
Lina (CS Manager): proposed comms plan — short timeline and owners: 1) Immediate ack to customer (Omar) within 30m; 2) Triage + temporary mitigation (Devon) within 2h — try rate-limit bump and restart; 3) Enablement call with customer + demo of resilient ingest flow (Lina + Devon) within 6h; 4) Follow-up doc + ticket update and renewal health check (Aisha) within 24h.
Aisha (CS Ops): I'll prepare the post-call action checklist and update the renewal tracker. Assigning follow-up items in our CS playbook.
Omar (Support): acked. Sent provisional message to Halogen and scheduled a short standup at 16:30 PST. Customer accepted.
Evelyn (Customer): thank you — appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll keep logs on hand and be on the 16:30 call.
Devon (Solutions Eng): quick mitigation steps to try pre-call: 
- toggle `adapter.parallelism` from 4 -> 2
- enable KV prefix cache (temp)
- restart ingest-worker with `--grace 10s`
If that doesn't stabilize, we'll route to fallback store and keep the dataset live for validation.
Lina (CS Manager): great. I'll lead the enablement call and cover the fallback option to avoid renewal churn. cc @oncall-bot so SRE knows potential escalation path.
oncall-bot: alert created: SRE-4579 (watch vector-store adapter). Priority: P2.
Omar (Support): I'll update ticket#98214 with comms plan + mitigation steps. Will report back here after the 16:30 call. :thumbsup:
Aisha (CS Ops): adding customer sentiment note to CRM and flagging renewal contact for outreach post-resolution.
Lina (CS Manager): thanks team. If pre-call mitigation works, we'll run the enablement walkthrough and capture a step-by-step remediation doc to avoid recurrence. If not, we'll prepare a short exec summary for the renewal sponsor.
Devon (Solutions Eng): prepping a minimal repro and an ops command list to share on the call.
Omar (Support): 16:30 call done — mitigation (reduce parallelism + restart) stabilized ingest. Customer validating remaining rows. Updating ticket now.
Lina (CS Manager): awesome. Post-call actions: Aisha to send follow-up email template, Devon to push a config note to onboarding guide, Omar to close loop in ticket, and I'll ping renewal sponsor with positive update.
Evelyn (Customer): ingest resumed, pilot validation progressing. thanks!
Lina (CS Manager): marking this thread resolved from CS escalation perspective. Closing loop in tracker and scheduling a 1-week check-in to ensure renewal confidence. :white_check_mark:
